user.title: GC Manager
user.description: Manage Python garbage collection to keep gen-2 pauses small on a large instance.

data.startup_delay_seconds: Settle delay after an HA restart before the first freeze (seconds; 0 = immediate). Ignored on install/reload.
data.pause_gc_until_freeze: Keep automatic collection off during an HA start, until the startup freeze has run (needs the startup freeze; uses more memory for those minutes)
data.sample_interval_minutes: Period of the tracked-object-count sampler (minutes). Each tick walks the unfrozen heap while the tracked-objects sensor is enabled; a larger value spreads the GIL hitch out on big instances.
data.refreeze_interval_hours: Periodic re-freeze interval (hours, 0 = off; rounded to a divisor of 24 and aligned to the maintenance time)
data.daily_maintenance: Daily unfreeze + collect + freeze (if off, the periodic re-freeze does this reset instead)

error.no_reset_schedule: Freezing needs a reset: enable daily maintenance or a periodic re-freeze interval above 0, or turn the startup freeze off.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: Run gc.collect() then gc.freeze() now, absorbing current long-lived objects into the frozen set.

unfreeze.name: Unfreeze
unfreeze.description: Return all frozen objects to normal garbage collection.

maintain.name: Maintain
maintain.description: Run unfreeze + collect + freeze now (the full daily-maintenance reset) to reclaim frozen-then-dead objects.
